results.description:
She threw scalding milk at armed men. He grins like death is a suggestion.

Wren Callahan built Black Hills Brew from nothing—two years of eighteen-hour days to prove she wasn't the family disappointment everyone expected. When a casino developer decides her coffee stand is blocking his forty-million-dollar project, she tells him to shove his offer. Now she's being hunted by muscle who've made obstacles disappear before.

He's been chasing adrenaline his whole life. She's about to become his reason to slow down.

Brennan "Stuntman" Cross spent a decade doing things on motorcycles that made insurance companies weep. Now he rides for the Black Hills Riders because standing still feels like dying. When he finds Wren under siege, something shifts. She's chaos wrapped in caffeine and stubborn backbone—exactly the trouble he's been running toward.

Too bad she doesn't want rescuing.

What starts as club business becomes an obsession neither expected. But the developer wants Wren broken, and he's willing to burn everything she's built. Her trailer. Her home. Her proof that chaos can become something beautiful.

In the Black Hills, the club handles threats with violence. And Stuntman is about to show a rich man what happens when you torch something that belongs to him.

This book was previously published under a different pen name.
